purpose: span[role=img] painted with bg-<ink> through mask-image:url(logo); used for every monochrome logo (customer marquees, rotating grids, header wordmark).
rules: mask-size contain, mask-position center, no-repeat; color comes from a bg-ink-* token.

In generated mode only brand.placeholder / brand.user-supplied (and the placeholder-only customer.logo) may be painted; the real brand.* roles and badge.backer are reference-mode only (assets/asset-roles.json availability).
